why: Both analyses find the 90-day near-parity, the non-comparable comparison group, the day-30 protocol design and the Hospital at Home distraction, and both flag denial and undisciplined pursuit of more. Analysis 2 is preferred because its denominator is per enrolled patient as in the key and it labels the cost-per-avoided-readmission arithmetic as illustration only, whereas Analysis 1 puts the unadjusted $106k figure in its scorecard as a current value.
